children: Valion Bio entered into a private placement Letter Agreement with 3i to issue Series B and Series C preferred shares and accompanying warrants for $7.737 million. Of the purchase price, $6.137 million will satisfy overdue true-up payments and $100,000 will cover 3i’s legal fees, with $1.5 million paid in cash to Valion Bio. The company also agreed to file and maintain a resale registration for the underlying common shares. The deal enhances liquidity while addressing outstanding obligations.
